> AI disclosure: I am not a software developer. Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5) prepared and tested this merge; an independent Claude Fable 5.1 review approved it before submission; this is not a claim of human developer review. Claude Code cloud session, CPU only, no GPU testing.

Test scope: CPU build/tests and a full HIP compile only, on an x86-64 cloud VM with no GPU and no RDMA. `nix build .#tp2-rdma` (HIP for gfx1151, `GUFO_ENABLE_TP2_RDMA=ON`) built. `cmake --build --preset pr` passed 62/62. `ctest -L tp2` passed 3/3. `check-format.py` with the pinned clang-tools passed. Nothing ran on a GPU or over RDMA, so this branch has no hardware result yet.

@neuhaus, for when you merge the next upstream commits: [`jabata:cloud/rdma-merge-main`](https://github.com/jabata/gufo/tree/cloud/rdma-merge-main) is one merge commit, current upstream `main` (`3389a58`, #630) into `rdma` `3eb33a5`. It does not include neuhaus#7 or #8. It goes past the merge in my earlier comment (which stopped at `78248de`) by #626 and #630. It resolves the conflicts my earlier notes describe the same way, including the PLE wait (`embeddings_ready = graph && tp_world_size() == 1`). `git show --remerge-diff` on the merge commit shows every resolution. Two of them are worth a look: the first is new with #626, and my earlier notes did not describe the second:

- **`kernels.hip.cpp`, `RoutedF16GEMMKernel` (#626 against `kWaveOwned`):** #626 stages Q5_1 rows in LDS as stored, while `rdma` replaced `kPair` with `kWaveOwned = kPair && !kQ8` in the same lines. I kept `kWaveOwned` and added the Q5_1 terms: `kCodeBytes = kWaveOwned ? 0 : kQ5 ? BM * kQ5Bytes : BM * kChunks * 16`, `kHighBytes` only for Q5_K, `kScaleBytes = 0` for `kWaveOwned || kQ5`, and `compute_stage`'s LDS code-load guard `!kQ8 && !kQ5 && !kWaveOwned`. Q5_1 never runs paired (the paired launches are Q4_K, Q5_K and Q8_0 only), so the two changes do not interact. For Q5_K and Q4_K, `kWaveOwned` equals `kPair`. The paired Q8_0 kernel keeps `rdma`'s staging.
- **`serve.cpp`, the `LoadingResponder` from #610:** rank 1 serves no HTTP, so only rank 0 (or a single host) answers 503 `Loading model` while the model loads. Rank 1 leaves the port alone.

The `MtpHead` (split argmax only when `draft == nullptr`), `Attention` (per-rank heads plus the compacted lists) and `inference_backend.cpp` resolutions match my earlier notes.

Built in a cloud session (CPU only); Strix Halo validation pending.

review.summary: All eight conflict resolutions are semantically correct for both single-host and TP2 (kWaveOwned/Q5_1 never share an instantiation; the TP PLE guard is required because MixerPart still calls Ple(false); MtpHead split-argmax correctly gated on draft==nullptr; rank 1 never serves HTTP). Nothing in the auto-merged draft-subset or attention-list code is broken by the combination. Comment disclosure, test-scope wording and privacy checks pass; one informational clause lacks an evidence entry.
